column1: # Plugin version mapping (single source of truth for the rundeck-plugins version-bump skill)
#   plugin_repo     = repo name under github.com/rundeck-plugins (also the gh release source)
#   core_prop       = property name in rundeck/gradle.properties (<prop>=<ver>), or - if Core does not bundle it
#   rundeckpro_prop = property name in rundeckpro/gradle.properties, or - if not consumed
#   ua_runner_prop  = property name in ua-runner/gradle.properties, or - if not consumed
#   - Core (rundeck) reads these *PluginVersion props from gradle.properties; build.gradle interpolates
#     them into bundledPlugins and testbuild.groovy reads them. build.yaml no longer carries versions.
#   - kubernetes uses kubernetesVersion in rundeckpro but kubernetesPluginVersion in ua-runner.
#   - nixy-step-plugins publishes one release that drives nixystepVersion (4 artifacts share it).
